summary: Ecopetrol S.A. furnished a Form 6-K on 2026-10-01 disclosing the termination of Cristina Toro Restrepo as Corporate Vice President of Legal Affairs and General Secretary, effective 2026-09-30, by company decision. Silvia Restrepo Garcia Reyes, currently Corporate and Shareholder Affairs Manager, becomes acting Corporate VP of Legal Affairs and General Secretary from 2026-10-01, with a permanent successor to be announced. No terms, advisors, board recommendation, or regulatory clock are stated. The abrupt legal-officer exit, with only an interim appointment and no named permanent replacement or stated reason, is the event to watch.
